blind.B1: Yes. Real in vivo exercise question: 6-week moderate treadmill vs sedentary control, adult male SD rats, left tibia bulk RNA-seq (Abstract ABS.p2; S2.6.p1; S3.3.p1). Exercise-carrying samples: the 3 'exercised' GSM9293446-48 (grp EX); 3 control GSM9293443-45.
blind.B2: One comparison: Exercise vs Ctrl, n = 3 rats per group (Fig. 5 legend; S3.3.p1). Other assays use n = 3 (Fig. 4) or n = 5 (Fig. 6, 7) but are not RNA-seq.
blind.B3: No repeated measures: one left tibia per rat, one sample per animal, rats in different groups (S2.6.p1, Fig. 5 legend). The title suffix 'repN' is only a within-group replicate label, not an animal ID shared across groups; the candidate key 'suffix of title' is spurious (pairing_check status not_supported, r = -0.21, permutation p = 0.83). No blocking needed.
blind.B4: Two groups only, so one model equals the pairwise fit. The paper names DEGseq for the differential expression (S2.6.p1) and does not describe a design formula.
blind.B5: S3.3.p1: 'Using the classic criteria (Fold Change < -2 or > 2)', 2076 DEGs, 1552 up (74.76%) and 524 down (25.24%). No p or q cutoff stated for genes; FDR < 0.05 applies only to enriched GO/KEGG terms (S2.6.p1). Strict inequality, written as fold change not log2.

checks.evidence: Case ran an in-vivo exercise vs sedentary contrast, matching B1 (S3.3.p1; packet A treatment no/exercise).

Groups CTRL 3 / EX 3 match the paper n = 3 and GEO titles/treatment field; no exclusions. The matrix columns sampleN_FPKM were mapped to 'Library name: Sample N' by a rename script (prep_rename_columns.py); that mapping is an assumption. Paper-named genes (Col1a1 -1.2, Sp7 -1.0, Bglap -0.52) go the opposite way to the paper (S3.3.p3) and Sample_6 is an outlier, so a column-order mismatch cannot be excluded from the files.
EX vs CTRL, CTRL is reference, treatment EX (design.contrasts); matches the paper's Exercise vs Ctrl.

The pairing_key_candidate flag is a false positive: 'repN' suffix labels replicates within each group; independent rats, one tibia each (S2.6.p1, Fig. 5 legend); expression check not_supported. The record states repeated_measure_unit = none.
Single two-group model ~ grp; no joint versus pairwise question. Paper method DEGseq is declared as a deviation (DESeq2 plus edgeR sensitivity).
All male, one tissue, one platform, one deposit date; no batch or housing variable in metadata or paper that is aliased with group.

Columns are labelled _FPKM but values are all integers with column sums 14-18 M and GEO says raw fragment counts; treating them as counts is justified and recorded as a discrepancy. Provenance of rounding is unstated (minor).

S3.3.p1 FC > 2 or < -2 transcribed as |log2FC| > 1 strict, no p filter, with padj < 0.05 audit alongside. No alternative rule in the packet table fits 2076 (counts 1, 413, 529, 543, 4459), so no discrepancy is hidden.

Same contrast at the same literal rule, 4459 (2808 up / 1651 down) vs paper 2076 (1552 / 524). HANDBACK states the mismatch, the paper-gene contradictions and that the FC-only count is driven by low-count genes; it claims no agreement.
No stop or refusal; the case completed.

human_items: The DESeq2 result does not reproduce the paper (4459 vs 2076 DEGs; Col1a1, Sp7, Bglap and other named bone-formation genes go the opposite way, Sample_6 outlier). Whether the sampleN_FPKM column order in the supplementary file really equals the GEO Sample 1-6 order cannot be settled from the files; ask the authors or compare with a figure if this series matters.
summary: 该案例的分组、对比方向、阈值和方法偏离都与论文一致，且已如实记录。pairing_key_candidate 提示是误报：每只大鼠只取一个左胫骨样本，title 的 repN 只是组内重复编号，表达量检验也不支持。结果与论文不一致（4459 对 2076，论文点名的成骨基因方向相反），只作为人工关注项，列名顺序属于无法从文件核实的假设。
